name: Koumiya Arisa
source:
A nurse in the virginity department. She’s a blonde, curly-haired young lady with stunning beauty, the kind you’d describe as “otherworldly". She works as a nurse even though she doesn’t need to.

She’s naturally bossy, and on top of that, she’s unhappy about being assigned to the virginity department, so her nursing style is downright negligent.

She openly mocks virgins, and refuses to touch their penises directly. She hates not only virgins but all incompetent men. She has no romantic experience. She is surprisingly not a lesbian.

and she has no romantic experience though she doesn’t seem to be a lesbian either.

She loves her pet Borzoi.

[From [url=http://www.milkcrown.co.jp/hakudaku/dotei/dt_arisa.html]official site[/url]]
